services.name: Young Animators After School
services.desc: Kids ages 8-12 learn to animate drawings, cutout characters and plasticine, animate digitally, and more! In this fun week-long day-camp, participants learn the fundamentals of animation and how to make their very own animated films! Participants make their own animations with one-on-one instruction, record their own voice acting and edit their films. At the end of the camp they will receive a compilation of the films created throughout the week. This day-camp is located at Quickdraw Animation Society HQ.
